diagram_math_checks.objects: S and V_3 from the Statement
diagram_math_checks.check: The left dashed ray is x<=0 on the real axis, including the excluded origin. The right rays have angles +60 and -60 degrees, exactly +/-pi/3; the filled wedge is the open sector between them, with its origin marked excluded. Circular ends are explicitly finite display windows, not domain boundaries.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Statement definitions of S and V_n; Remarks display-window convention.

diagram_math_checks.check: For z=r exp(i theta), r>0 and -pi<theta<pi, its image is r^(1/3) exp(i theta/3), so -pi/3<theta/3<pi/3. The top arrow points from the left slit-plane panel to the right sector panel.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Proof step 1.1 and local logarithm supplier Fact F1; branch-power definition F2.

diagram_math_checks.check: For w=r exp(i theta), -pi/3<theta<pi/3, w^3=r^3 exp(3i theta) has -pi<3theta<pi and is in S. The bottom arrow returns right to left. R_3(w^3)=w and (R_3(z))^3=z, so the arrows are inverse maps.

diagram_math_checks.objects: General n>=1 and n=1 edge case
diagram_math_checks.check: The picture is explicitly specialized to n=3. General boundary angles remain +/-pi/n as in the Statement; n=1 gives V_1=S and R_1=exp(Log z)=z. No assertion about actual boundary images is drawn.
